existing_features.title: Ensure all time durations displayed throughout the application (Dashboard, Calendar, Reports pages) are formatted in hours (e.g., '7h30' or '7.5h') rather than minutes or any other unit. Audit all time-related display values across all pages and components and apply a consistent hours-based format.

new_feature_requests.summary: Afficher le format horaire en heures (et non en minutes ou autre format)
